about: Benchmark sessions for scripts/rerun/rerun.py bench: whole sessions (every detector) chosen where known things are, so the same run gives speed and size per photo and the found/missed checks. A target names `sessions` (the zone's session numbers), `obs` (observation-number prefixes) or `pick: largest` (the zone's session with the most photos).

targets.why: asteroid (74) Galatea V 13.9 in D6 (lost to the old glow bug); known asteroids; the v2 measurement bands
the session-stack measurement sessions: Gaia G50 per detector, 109 known asteroids V < 18.5
comet 306P/LINEAR (the only grade A mover; its D3 image at S/N 4.4 was only in the peaks file)
WISE 0855-0714: coldest brown dwarf, MWIR only, 8"/yr
Epsilon Indi B: T dwarf pair next to a bright star
RW Aurigae: variable young star, saturates
galactic centre: confusion, the plane D4 -5.7% of Gaia stars
north ecliptic pole: deepest coverage, high latitude
comet 135P/Shoemaker-Levy (rb_score once ranked it 372nd in grade C)
Saturn's moons Titan V 8.5, Rhea 9.9, Iapetus 11.3 (once listed as unknown movers)
fast near-Earth asteroids: 2006 GC1 1,284"/h V 18.3, 2026 GU 911"/h V 19.0, 2025 TX2 3,117"/h V 19.8 (trails)
